Name: Auto Stack Items to Chest
Author: chosimba0001
Description:
[b]Auto Stack Items Mod

[/b]This mod is simple: Whenever a player opens a chest, any items that are found in the chest as well as the player's inventory are automatically moved into the chest.

Any items that cannot be stacked or stored are ignored by this mod. For example, if there is a pair of Firewalker Boots in a chest and in the player's inventory, it will not be moved to the chest.

The mod also distinguishes between quality of items. For example, if there are a stack of Blackberry's in the chest and a golden quality Blackberry in the player's inventory, it will not be moved. It will, however, stack same-quality items if they are found in the chest and player's inventory.


After items have been stacked into the chest, auto-stacking will not occur again until that menu is closed.

[b]Can be toggled on and off using the [size=4]F3 [size=3]key.[/size][/size][/b]
